conditions.workload: Fixed ceil(seconds/feed_period) rounds; delayed rounds are retained and actual duration reported

scope: Actual repeats retained, no statistical-significance claim.
Fixed counters end before final drain; lifecycle adds independent complete drain plus2.2s static empty guard and final counters.
Low-flow RCON bounds are capability acceptance to actual extraction, not physical chest/world save.
Each JVM histogram is independent: no cross-JVM nanoTime subtraction. Sparse quantiles are upper-bin bounds; sums are wall durations, not CPU timers.
Actual TPS is achieved tick-start rate in each explicit window, not target or instantaneous TPS.
frame_depth_mismatches does not count deeper-than64 overflow; frame_overflow_count=UNMEASURED.
Agent generator span means ThreeServerHarness.tick, not Python input generation. External observer drive/RCON timings are retained separately.

clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.
